test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 2 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Austere
solution:
The correct answer is: **Stern.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Austere** means severe or strict in manner or attitude.

 
 
• **Example -** *Even though she appeared **austere**, my teacher was a very kind woman.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Stern** means serious and unrelenting, especially in the assertion of authority and exercise of discipline.
 
 
• **Example -** *'We will take the necessary steps,' she said **sternly**.*
 
 
 
• It is clear that **'Austere'** and **'Stern'** are similar in meaning.
 
• Therefore the correct answer is **option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Promising** means showing signs of future success.
 
• **Brisk** means quick in manner or movement; energetic.
 
• **Mitigating **means making something less severe or less unpleasant.
